description: Whats your finesse? Whats that thing that sets you apart? #fyp #lifebydesign #careeradvice #leadershipdevelopment #30something
transcript: The trick to life is to know and understand your finesse. You don't need to take anyone else's style, mannerisms, anything of that nature. You need to learn how you operate in spaces. You need to learn what you have that the person next to you doesn't. And that's how you operate in life. It does not need to be a performance. Just figure out what works and allow it to be organic. One thing for me is I am not shy. I will walk in any room and set a goal and say, oh, I want that. And by the end of the night, I will have that. Because my finesse is my mouthpiece. Know what your strong suit is.
